proof_checkpoints: Conditional projection identity, normal fourth moment, a=0 and almost-sure uniqueness verified.
Exactly-two-gesture events are disjoint; success parameter positive below1, geometric holding times independent via constant conditional law, equal probabilities checked.
Censored likelihood integrated piecewise; coincident thresholds, a=j logarithms and positive lower endpoints checked.
Saturated demand excludes k>L; strict concave quadratic and nearest-integer ties cover k=0 and all boundaries.
Rotational invariance gives angular disagreement theta/pi; strong law and CLT include degenerate collinear endpoints.
Inclusion-exclusion tail, uniform weak-composition gap bijection and max=min decomposition checked without independence.
Variance logarithmic, exp(k^2) subsequence Chebyshev summable, countable BC and monotone interpolation valid; critical case explicitly excluded.
Long-fragment density2, conditional triangle interval and normalized mean1/(4*(2log2-1)) checked.
Circle itself versus disk distinguished: diagonal tile iff corner distance<r; three-tile corner squares minus quarters; two-tile remainder nonnegative.
Complex cross-correlations, finite geometric formula and asymptotic diffusion coefficient verified, rho1 deterministic and other unit-modulus finite formulas valid.
